sections.label: BACKGROUND & SURFACE
sections.description: Page grounds and layered surfaces. `base` is the app ground — everything else in this file sits on it. No ratio column: a ground measured against itself says nothing.

sections.label: BORDER
sections.description: Hairlines and dividers, measured against `background/base`. Ratio only, no verdict — WCAG 1.4.11 exempts purely decorative dividers, so a low number here is a design choice rather than a defect. Judge it by eye against the swatch.

sections.label: TEXT
sections.description: The reading ladder, measured against `background/base`. The bar is 4.5:1 for body copy and 3:1 for large text.

sections.label: INTERACTION
sections.description: Focus and selection affordances, measured against `background/base`. These DO answer to 1.4.11 at 3:1 — a focus ring is a UI component indicator, not decoration.

sections.label: STATUS STRIP
sections.description: Run-state strip fills against `background/base`. Ratio only: whether these need 3:1 depends on whether the strip is the sole carrier of the state or is paired with a label, which varies by component.

sections.label: ACCENT
sections.description: The single accent rail — one name carrying a value per mode. `sidebar-primary` is the only value that actually differs between modes. Each `-foreground` is measured against its own accent surface, not against the page ground.

sections.label: FONT FAMILIES
sections.description: The role layer reads these as --font-sans and --font-mono.

sections.label: SIZE RAMP
sections.description: Seven steps, 2pt-tuned for Collider. Each line is set at its own token size.

sections.label: ROLE ALIASES
sections.description: Usage-named aliases onto the size ramp, carried over from Collider-Old. New work picks from the ramp; this block grows as atoms formalise.

sections.label: LEADING
sections.description: Line-height multipliers shown on wrapped text at the configured sample font size. A leading variable binds as pixels, so the multiplier is converted to percent rather than bound.

sections.label: TRACKING
sections.description: Letter-spacing. `wide` is what the small uppercase section headers on this page use. Tracking is authored in em and Figma would bind it as a raw percentage, so it is resolved against each sample’s own size rather than bound.

sections.label: SPACING SCALE
sections.description: 20 steps from 0 to 128px. Bars are drawn at the token’s actual width.

sections.label: GAP ROLE ALIASES
sections.description: Usage-named steps inherited from Collider-Old atoms.

sections.label: PADDING ROLE ALIASES
sections.description: Usage-named padding steps inherited from Collider atoms; direct token-width specimens.

sections.label: RADIUS
sections.description: Corner radii drawn on specimen boxes. Full radius clamps to a pill at the displayed size.

sections.label: RADIUS ROLE ALIASES
sections.description: Usage-named values from Collider tokens; specimens reflect the explicit frame mode.

sections.label: BORDER WIDTHS
sections.description: Tailwind v4 defaults `border` to currentColor; the role bridge restores the semantic colour.

sections.label: OPACITY
sections.description: Applied to a solid accent fill on the page ground. An opacity variable binds as a percentage, so 0.7 would land as 0.7% — the value is read from the token and applied, not bound.

sections.label: OPACITY ROLE ALIASES
sections.description: Usage-named values from Collider tokens; specimens reflect the explicit frame mode.

sections.label: LEVELS
sections.description: The raw shadow ramp, drawn on cards using the configured page-ground role. Padding includes the full effect reach; CSS strings are derived effects, not variable-bound shadows.

sections.label: ROLE ALIASES
sections.description: Which surface uses which level.

sections.label: DURATIONS
sections.description: Usage-named values from Collider tokens; specimens reflect the explicit frame mode.

sections.label: EASING
sections.description: Usage-named values from Collider tokens; specimens reflect the explicit frame mode.

sections.label: CONTAINERS
sections.description: Max content widths for route shells and reading columns.

sections.label: GUTTERS
sections.description: Usage-named values from Collider tokens; specimens reflect the explicit frame mode.

sections.label: WEIGHTS
sections.description: Poppins ships all four. Roboto Mono is used at 400 and 500 only. Figma names a weight as a font style rather than a number, so these samples cannot bind type/weight — the style is matched by hand.

sections.label: APPEAR ROLE
sections.description: Paired duration and easing for appear. Both source leaves are shown together as values, not a preview of the animation.

sections.label: DISMISS ROLE
sections.description: Paired duration and easing for dismiss. Both source leaves are shown together as values, not a preview of the animation.

sections.label: HOVER ROLE
sections.description: Paired duration and easing for hover. Both source leaves are shown together as values, not a preview of the animation.
